decisions.reason: As a dedicated-page consumable aligned with core dental custom manufacturing, its option remains valuable and cheap to keep while market response is still uncertain.
The PETG blank fits the firm's move toward digital manufacturing and has a dedicated page, so the firm keeps this low-cost option open until demand clarifies.
The UV-curing lacquer has only a website mention and is less central to digital workflows, raising its drop probability, but its option can still be retained at little cost.
The intraoral contrast spray supports digital workflows and has a dedicated page, yet adoption uncertainty warrants a moderate drop probability while keeping the option.
The custom earmold line expands the firm's hearing-care business and, despite limited website presence, remains a cheap option to keep open.
Custom hearing protection earmolds fit an established channel and offer option value, so the firm keeps this low-cost option while results continue to resolve.
